samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
    <description>Fixed-point subtractor with precision control.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">Resulting value after subtraction.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="Q">Number of fractional bits.</parameter>
        <parameter id="N">Total number of bits including integer and fractional parts.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <signal id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]" />
        <assign res = ($signed(a[N-1:Q]) + $signed(b[N-1:Q])) - ($signed(~a[N-1:Q]) + $signed(~b[N-1:Q])); // Same sign subtraction
        <assign res[N-1] = 1'b0;
        
        <always @(*) begin
            if (a[N-1] == b[N-1]) begin // Same sign subtraction
                res[N-1-Q:N-Q] = a[N-1-Q:N-Q] - b[N-1-Q:N-Q];
                res[N-1] = a[N-1];
            end else begin // Different sign subtraction
                if (a[N-1] == 1'b0 && b[N-1] == 1'b1) begin // Positive minus negative
                    if (a[N-1:Q] > b[N-1:Q]) begin
                        res[N-1-Q:N-Q] = a[N-1:Q] + ~b[N-1:Q] + 1;
                        res[N-1] = 1'b1;
                    end else begin
                        res[N-1-Q:N-Q] = b[N-1:Q] + ~a[N-1:Q] + 1;
                        res[N-1] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end else begin // Negative minus positive
                    if (~a[N-1:Q] > ~b[N-1:Q]) begin
                        res[N-1-Q:N-Q] = a[N-1:Q] + ~b[N-1:Q] + 1;
                        res[N-1] = 1'b0;
                    end else begin
                        res[N-1-Q:N-Q] = b[N-1:Q] + ~a[N-1:Q] + 1;
                        res[N-1] = 1'b1;
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        
        <assign c = res;
    </logic_description>
    <implementation></implementation>
    <task></task>
</module>
